requirements.text: Capture once, reuse many times: information is entered where it arises and reused downstream (SAP S/4 financials, COUPA procurement, FastDraft NEC, Primavera P6 schedule).
requirements.metric: SAP, COUPA-style PO and Copperleaf reused without re-keying
requirements.evidence: FastDraft and Primavera P6 data are not part of the input workbook.

requirements.text: Separate the three grains: commercial approval, financial posting and analytical reporting grains may differ; their relationships must be explicit, controlled and auditable.
requirements.metric: 6 PO lines → 16 WBS allocations → 50 investments
requirements.evidence: Commercial (PO Summary), posting (SAP Data) and analytical (Allocation, Copperleaf) grains are joined by PO number, WBS element and SAP project.

requirements.text: Simple approvals, accessible detail: approvers see scope, value, progress, quality, forecast effect and material exceptions; detailed coding by drill-down.
requirements.metric: 6 POs with summary, consumption and exception indicators
requirements.evidence: PO view summarises value, posted, remaining commitment and flags; WBS coding by drill-down.

requirements.text: No artificial PO-line proliferation unless a genuine commercial, accounting or control need exists.
requirements.metric: 6 PO lines carry 16 WBS allocations (2.7× detail)
requirements.evidence: Each PO is a single summary line; WBS detail lives in the governed allocation schedule.

requirements.text: Exceptions receive attention: routine compliant transactions are streamlined; manual review focuses on material changes, control failures, ambiguous mappings and reconciliation breaks.
requirements.metric: 112 exceptions raised
requirements.evidence: Rule-based exception queue with owner (SAP Person Responsible) and requirement reference.

requirements.text: Preserve evidence and history: original transactions, submissions, mapping versions, allocation rules, approvals and corrections remain reproducible and auditable.
requirements.metric: Source row number retained on every record
requirements.evidence: Each record keeps its workbook row; mapping version is stamped. Version history of submissions is not in the input.

requirements.text: End-to-end traceability from each regulatory investment to projects, interventions, activities, costs, outputs and evidence.
requirements.acceptance: Sampled investment traces to source transactions and delivered outputs without an uncontrolled break.
requirements.metric: 99.0% of SAP actual attributed to an investment
requirements.evidence: Investment → SAP project → WBS → PO allocation chain built from Copperleaf % of WBS.

requirements.text: Attribute project-execution cost to project, WBS, site, activity type and asset intervention at the agreed reporting grain.
requirements.acceptance: Each in-scope cost contains or is associated by an approved rule with the required dimensions.
requirements.metric: 98.5% of gross actual on placeholder activity codes
requirements.evidence: Regulatory activity code must be specific for activity-level attribution.

requirements.text: Link delivered cost and output back to the planned investment submitted to the regulator.
requirements.acceptance: Regulatory investment reference and applicable version are present in reporting lineage.
requirements.metric: 25 submissions, 50 investments
requirements.evidence: Regulatory submission reference and price base carried into the investment view.

requirements.text: Preserve the relationship between commitment, baseline, latest forecast, actual, ETC and final outturn.
requirements.acceptance: Controlled reports show each measure and variance using approved definitions and versions.
requirements.metric: Commitment, actual and planned ECC shown; baseline/forecast/ETC not in input
requirements.evidence: PO value (commitment), SAP YTD (actual) and Copperleaf ECC (plan) kept as distinct measures.

requirements.text: Avoid creating a second financial ledger outside the authoritative finance system.
requirements.acceptance: Management and regulatory totals reconcile to authoritative financial actuals.
requirements.metric: 15 of 16 allocated WBS elements exceed their SAP actual.
requirements.evidence: Allocation schedule compared with SAP posted actual on each WBS.

requirements.text: Support regional projects and Major Programmes through a common core model with controlled variants.
requirements.acceptance: Variants have documented applicability, justification, ownership and version.
requirements.evidence: The input workbook does not contain data for this requirement.

requirements.text: Maintain a simple, proportionate PO and approval process for operational approvers.
requirements.acceptance: Representative users complete standard scenarios without unnecessary detail or navigation.
requirements.evidence: The input workbook does not contain data for this requirement.

requirements.text: Determine approval detail by the decision being made, not by the most granular reporting requirement.
requirements.acceptance: Approval views summarise decision-relevant information and provide optional drill-down.
requirements.metric: 6 POs with summary, consumption and exception indicators
requirements.evidence: PO view summarises value, posted, remaining commitment and flags; WBS coding by drill-down.

requirements.text: Do not require separate PO lines for every activity, intervention or regulatory category unless justified.
requirements.acceptance: Design demonstrates analytical detail without artificial PO-line proliferation.
requirements.metric: 6 PO lines carry 16 WBS allocations (2.7× detail)
requirements.evidence: Each PO is a single summary line; WBS detail lives in the governed allocation schedule.

requirements.text: Minimise duplicate entry of project, WBS, activity, site, intervention, contract and investment information.
requirements.acceptance: Authoritative values are reused or derived in representative scenarios.
requirements.evidence: The input workbook does not contain data for this requirement.

requirements.text: Support different but connected granularity for commercial approval, financial posting and analytical reporting.
requirements.acceptance: Information model defines the relationship between all three grains.
requirements.metric: 6 PO lines → 16 WBS allocations → 50 investments
requirements.evidence: Commercial (PO Summary), posting (SAP Data) and analytical (Allocation, Copperleaf) grains are joined by PO number, WBS element and SAP project.

requirements.text: Approve a PO at aggregated commercial level while its supporting schedule holds granular activity, site or intervention detail.
requirements.acceptance: Aggregated PO reconciles to its detailed schedule.
requirements.metric: 6/6 POs reconcile to their allocation schedule
requirements.evidence: PO actual posted equals Σ final allocated and allocation % totals 100%.

requirements.text: Capture detailed supplier cost through FastDraft, APS or another controlled schedule where PO lines would be disproportionate.
requirements.acceptance: Detailed records reconcile without equivalent PO-line creation.
requirements.evidence: The input workbook does not contain data for this requirement.

requirements.text: Maintain a persistent, versioned, auditable relationship between each aggregated PO line and its detailed cost schedule.
requirements.acceptance: Detailed cost traces to PO, PO line, contract and financial posting.
requirements.metric: 16 allocation lines traced to SAP WBS
requirements.evidence: Allocation ID → PO → WBS → SAP posting.

requirements.text: The supporting cost schedule must not become a separate financial ledger.
requirements.acceptance: Analytical detail reconciles to SAP S/4 posted actuals.

requirements.evidence: Allocation schedule compared with SAP posted actual on each WBS.

requirements.text: Avoid PO amendment for redistribution of granular cost where commitment, scope and thresholds are unchanged.
requirements.acceptance: Controlled redistribution occurs without unnecessary reapproval.

requirements.text: Trigger PO change or reapproval only for defined commercial, financial, scope, quality or control conditions.
requirements.acceptance: Trigger conditions are approved and applied consistently.
requirements.metric: 6 POs within committed value
requirements.evidence: Actual > PO value is raised as a reapproval trigger.

requirements.text: Provide approvers with summary and exception indicators, with drill-down to detail.
requirements.acceptance: Users can make informed decisions without reviewing every allocation line.
requirements.metric: 6 POs with summary, consumption and exception indicators
requirements.evidence: PO view summarises value, posted, remaining commitment and flags; WBS coding by drill-down.

requirements.text: Distinguish supplier-declared detail, system-derived classification and governed allocation.
requirements.acceptance: Each detailed record displays its origin and treatment.
requirements.metric: Origin shown on every detailed record
requirements.evidence: Allocation lines: governed allocation (rule); activity: system-derived (v1-system-derived); actuals: SAP posted.

requirements.text: Analytical classifications do not alter the legal or commercial meaning of the PO or contract.

requirements.text: Carry persistent identifiers connecting WBS to investments, interventions, contracts, sites and schedules.
requirements.acceptance: Cross-system matching works without free-text name matching.

requirements.evidence: Matching uses identifiers (WBS element, SAP project, PAC code), never names.
